question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**notable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the achievements of historical figures in contrast to child prodigies.
 
• The appropriate word should describe figures who had a significant impact on history.
 
• "**Notable**" fits well as it refers to people who are remarkable or worthy of attention.
 
• Other options ("**researcher**", "**dumb**", "**lame**") do not fit the context of describing historically significant individuals.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Researcher (अन्वेषक): "Researcher" refers to someone conducting studies or investigations, which does not fit the context.
 
• Dumb (मूर्ख): "Dumb" means lacking intelligence, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
 
• Lame (कमजोर): "Lame" means weak or unconvincing, which does not describe historical figures.
